verdict.rationale: Mailchimp publishes two documented public REST APIs. The Marketing API (root at GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/) has endpoints for creating contacts, sending campaigns and generating account exports. The Transactional (Mandrill) API covers sending messages, inbound routes, allowlists and IP provisioning, and both APIs offer documented webhooks with signature verification, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and evidence on authentication and rate-limit documentation.
